Confirm with user if other details are needed (like if the license should be kept in the pool for future use).
- Once we have all the information needed (user account, effective date, email forwarding, OOO, etc.) we can proceed with the account termination.
On 365 Admin (sign in with csupport@canyonmeadowsgolf.com), kick user from all active sessions and block direct logins.

*Once steps above are completed, The User Offboarding Form (can be found on Guides folder) must be completed by Club Support technicians when a client employee leaves the organization. It ensures that all systems are secured, access is removed, and documentation is recorded in the service ticket. Completed offboarding documents should be saved on the SharePoint folder (Tech Team Documents - Documents - User Offboarding - All Documents) for future reference. Please note that the form does not need to be completed in full in every case, as some sections may not be relevant depending on the client environment or the user’s role.
